thread:
Sam: Heads-up — noticed a spike in late ingest for EU around 03:20 UTC. Hourly aggregates missed ~6k events and the recompute queue is slow. Can we coordinate a targeted reconciliation for the affected shards? Thinking: tenant-aware backfill + temporary operator quota bump.
Neha: Which shards/tenants are we talking about? Any signs it's a downstream transform problem vs producer lag? I saw kafka consumer errors earlier: OffsetOutOfRange.
Liam: I can run ops. Two quick asks: (1) surface affected tenant list in console (per-tenant event count + last_seen) so we can pick priority; (2) safe preempt policy so operator bump doesn't evict critical long-running backfills.
Marta: Console has a reprocess modal but no operator_quota_bump toggle yet. We can add a short-lived flag on the modal; need the exact UX copy and auto-revert TTL. Also we should show estimated cost delta prominently.
Sam: Shards: s-eu-42, s-eu-43, s-eu-47. Root cause likely producer batching in EU region (still investigating). Minimal operator commands below — only use after thumbs-up:

```
# dry-run to preview cost + affected tenants
backfillctl preview --shard s-eu-42 --window "2026-03-20T03:00:00Z/2026-03-20T04:00:00Z"

# trigger operator-priority backfill with 2h burst quota
backfillctl trigger --shard s-eu-42 --window "2026-03-20T03:00:00Z/2026-03-20T04:00:00Z" --priority OPERATOR --quota-bump 2h --audit-note "EU late ingest 03:20"
```

Liam: Also plan to warm KV cache after trigger to avoid token/latency spikes: `curl -X POST https://internal.console/api/v1/kv/warm?shard=s-eu-42`
Neha: I'll validate ingest logs and confirm whether it's producer batching or a temporary spike in delivery latency. If it's producer-side we probably only need a narrow window and then fix producer batching.
Marta: For the UI toggle: propose label "Operator quota bump (auto-revert)" with a tooltip: "Grant short-lived extra capacity to finish targeted reprocesses. Operators only. Auto-reverts after TTL." Default TTL 2h, editable. I'll add cost warning.
Sam: Auto-revert 2h sounds good. Please ensure audit log + who triggered + revert timestamp are recorded in the run event. Also we should create a console snapshot after run for per-tenant deltas.
ops-bot: Playbook snippet: https://docs.internal/redwood/playbooks/recompute-ops — includes dry-run, preview, trigger patterns and required audit fields. Recommend: always run `preview` then `trigger --priority OPERATOR` for manual reconciliation.
Neha: I'll post a short log summary when I finish checks. Liam, can you schedule the run in 30m to give us time for dry-run? I can confirm root cause by then.
Liam: Oncall + handoff at 15:00 PT. I'll run the preview in 10m and, if green, trigger and monitor SLOs (latency, err rate) for 30m. Will post dashboard links as I go.
Marta: Created DEVOPS-1234 to add modal toggle + audit fields. Linking PR when ready.
Sam: Thanks all. After run please snapshot per-tenant counts and paste link to telemetry dashboard: https://console.redwood.local/telemetry/recompute/6159990000?shards=s-eu-42,s-eu-43,s-eu-47
Neha: quick note — if we see large tail for tenant X, we should consider splitting its backfill into sub-windows to avoid hogging burst slots.
Liam: Roger. I'll keep an eye on priority-lane fairness and preemption logs. Post-run I'll attach the `backfillctl` output and cost estimate.
Marta: :thumbsup: Will also add a small banner in modal: "Operator backfills billed to infra; confirm before trigger."
